answer: The delta graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the beacon audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 71 keys loses far more than 71 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the anchor checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
